novelty_basis: In substance the Guibas-Odlyzko comparison of patterns through their correlation polynomials (words avoiding a more self-overlapping pattern are more numerous); the codes share the avoidance denominator.

statement:
Let lambda_p = 1/rho_p, with rho_p the smallest positive root of x^k + (1 - 2x) c_p(x). Among binary patterns of
length k, 1^k and 0^k have the largest lambda_p and every other pattern has a strictly smaller one; hence
T_(1^k) has the smallest asymptotic codeword length log2(n)/log2(lambda) among length-k terminators.
title: The all-ones terminator 1^k (and 0^k) uniquely maximises the growth rate among length-k patterns
